display_long_description:
War Tank – Tanks Fighting Game puts you inside a high-intensity VR battlefield, where survival is the only mission. Designed exclusively for Meta Quest, this game delivers immersive tank combat in a hostile war zone filled with relentless enemy forces.

🔥 Endless Survival Gameplay
Face continuous waves of enemy tanks that grow stronger over time. There is no finish line—only your skill, strategy, and reaction speed determine how long you survive.

🎯 Realistic Tank Combat in VR
Aim and fire powerful tank cannons in full virtual reality. Track incoming enemies, manage your positioning, and destroy hostile tanks before they overwhelm you.

🛡️ Battle Arena Experience
Fight inside a dynamic combat area designed for nonstop action. Enemies approach from multiple directions, keeping every moment intense and unpredictable.

⚙️ Optimized for Meta Quest
Smooth performance, intuitive controls, and immersive VR visuals make War Tank a perfect VR action shooter for tank and war game fans.
